premise: Astronaut misses home; the telescope shows her the Earth up close, and the probe, far out, sends a picture of the Earth and the Moon together — tiny, and side by side.
inspiration: Johanna Spyri's Heidi (homesick on the mountain), turned: home can be seen from here, and from further out it's right next door.
lesson: Far away can also mean close together.

en-US.title: The Telescope Sees Home
en-US.text: {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face sad} Astronaut missed home. The blue Earth hung over the ridge, but it looked so far away. {telescope:enter} High above, the space telescope {telescope:live hold} turned its golden mirror toward the Earth. [gasps] {telescope:pulse} Suddenly home was close: blue oceans, white swirls of cloud, the curve of a coast. {astronaut:face surprised} Somewhere under that cloud was her town. {astronaut:face happy} [giggles] Probably raining. Then — {sfx:ping} ping — {astronaut:face surprised} a picture arrived from the {probe:enter} probe, far out on its long journey. {probe:live} It had turned round to look back. There, in one small picture: {probe:glow} the Earth and the Moon, side by side. Tiny. Close together, like two marbles in a pocket. {telescope:sparkle} {astronaut:face happy} [softly] From out there, she said, we're right next door. {astronaut:live} She tossed a pebble up and watched it float, {astronaut:hearts} and didn't feel so far away.

es-ES.title: El telescopio ve la Tierra
es-ES.text: {astronaut:enter} {astronaut:face sad} Astronauta echaba de menos su casa. La Tierra azul asomaba sobre la cordillera, pero parecía tan lejos… {telescope:enter} Allá arriba, el telescopio espacial {telescope:live hold} giró su espejo dorado hacia la Tierra. [gasps] {telescope:pulse} De repente, su casa estaba cerca: océanos azules, remolinos blancos de nubes, la curva de una costa. {astronaut:face surprised} Debajo de esa nube estaba su pueblo. {astronaut:face happy} [giggles] Seguro que llovía. Entonces — {sfx:ping} pin — {astronaut:face surprised} llegó una foto de la {probe:enter} sonda, muy lejos en su largo viaje. {probe:live} Se había dado la vuelta para mirar atrás. Allí, en una foto pequeñita: {probe:glow} la Tierra y la Luna, una al lado de la otra. Diminutas. Juntitas, como dos canicas en un bolsillo. {telescope:sparkle} {astronaut:face happy} [softly] Desde allí, dijo, somos vecinos. {astronaut:live} Lanzó un guijarro al aire, lo vio flotar {astronaut:hearts} y ya no se sintió tan lejos.

ping.prompt: a single soft, bright radio ping, like a message arriving, warm and gentle
